svg.title: AI Security Explained, Part 1: Sleeper Agents in Your AI Supply Chain
svg.desc: A single LoRA adapter chip is split down the middle by a jagged amber fracture, struck from above by the trigger word production. The left half of the same chip is calm and green and returns a safe parameterised query. The right half glows red and returns the query built by string concatenation, labelled SQL injection. One model, one set of weights, two behaviours.
